Required: Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 runtime for cosmetic loader
Optional: MetaHuman Creator Core Data and Epic sign-in
C++ development tools and Windows SDK for local Skin Details build
Setup: First run asks Play mods or Create mods. Prepared player downloads automatically set up the supported game/runtime without Epic, Unreal, Blender or mapping capture. Creator setup discovers tools and guides official installer/sign-in steps.

Validation.Scope: Visual supported native UI inspection in this chat: menu stock/ROWE selection, restart retention, real local pawn spawn and brief pose/firing/reload checks. No prolonged movement, respawn, friend-PC, arbitrary body fitting or wardrobe-network acceptance. Exact final assembly UI/package/ownership checks and a narrow actual clothing-cooker Mutable repair are separately verified.

DependencyStatus: ImageSharp 3.1.12 remains pinned with five advisories; bounded static PNG handoff. See DEPENDENCY-STATUS.md.
Note: Beta testing release. New MetaHuman heads and hairstyles still require separate game preparation.

AutomaticUpdates.Apply: After normal Studio exit and game/Unreal close

MetaHumanSetup.ExactSizes: Read selected components in Epic Launcher Options

MetaHumanSetup.LocalSkinDetailsBuild: Bundled source built for the installed editor

Workflow.Entry: Browse mods | My mods | Wardrobe | Create | Settings
Workflow.Player: Browse mods -> Subscribe -> matching wearer -> Wardrobe -> Play
Workflow.Texture: Create -> Edit textures -> select game item -> Export FBX & textures -> Substance or built-in Paint -> Import texture set -> Build & test
Workflow.Clothing: Create -> Make clothing -> body and rig fitting kit -> fit and weight paint in Blender -> import mesh and textures -> Build & test
Workflow.Character: Create -> Make a character -> MetaHuman Creator -> Send to RoweMod -> import -> prepare for game
Workflow.OutfitStorage: Independent compatible clothing slots on one wearer. Authored characters can save prepared garments/outfits; classic player profiles retain stock and prepared choices. Local selection persists across restart.
Workflow.Fitting: New clothing must be fitted and weighted to the supplied body and game rig; arbitrary bodies are not fitted automatically.
Workflow.MissingTextureRecovery: Same character/item → Textures → Import PNG or Import texture set → select matching PNG. Existing originals stay preserved; only if none survives does the selected PNG become the new starting texture.

CreatorRequired: Unreal Engine 5.8 for game asset cooking
Blender for mesh authoring and rig preparation
